bio: Wellington by Blue Orchid is situated in London’s famous Westminster district, within a moments’ walk from Buckingham Palace and the Palace of Westminster. The hotel offers guests a retreat from the flurry of the city whilst remaining within easy reach of Victoria’s leisure and entertainment facilities.  The Wellington hotel combines traditional elegance with contemporary style and modern décor. Overlooking gardens and a landscaped square, the hotel is nearby Victoria Station and St James’s Park Station.  You will be presented with Warm traditional scones served with thick clocked cream and rich strawberry preserve. Freshly cut fingers sandwiches with a variety of fillings. Selection of cakes and pastries. Selection of freshly brewed teas or choice of coffees. A glass of Prosecco can be provided with an extra charge.
